title: If you feel like you’ve lost everything in the fight, read this again. 👇
paragraphs: If you feel like you’ve lost everything in the fight, read this again. 👇
"God restores more than the enemy stole—He upgrades what was touched."

It hurts right now. The ashes of the battle are still smoldering. But God doesn’t just patch up wounds; He creates something entirely new out of them. He is taking what was meant to destroy you and using it to build an unshakeable foundation for your future. Your comeback will be bigger than your setback.
Don't give up just before the breakthrough. 🌅

📖 Bible Verse: "And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you." - 1 Peter 5:10
👇 Follow along if you need a reminder that God isn't finished with you yet.
